audience: small and mid-size companies that run sales, stock and invoicing in Directo

useCases.title: Find sales orders by status and customer
useCases.text: List sales orders with their lines, filtered by status, customer code or date. Read the customer cards of the same customers.

useCases.title: Check low stock by warehouse
useCases.text: List item cards with stock by warehouse. Filter the stock levels by quantity to find low stock.

useCases.title: Review sales invoices for a customer
useCases.text: List sales invoices with their lines, filtered by customer code, number or date.

useCases.title: Read any other Directo resource
useCases.text: Read the field names this key can see. Then list records such as suppliers, purchase invoices or receipts.

useCases.title: Pick up changes since the last sync
useCases.text: Read customers and items changed since a time, using the ts filter. Read in parts, because the API has no paging.
